Re-draw-sized losses were discarded: E046 -0.10, E049 -0.03, E031 -0.06, E036 -0.02. This is selection on noise. Stop logging '+0.17 pp' style keeps as evidence (E024~, E026~, E042~, E045~).

critiques.issue: The claim that the Muon base has a paired sd of <=0.06 pp rests on seven edits. Several of them barely change the trajectory: E038 and E032 leave the math nearly unchanged, E034 is identical through epoch 1, E035 is a post-training BN recalibration, and E028 may be a no-op. Edits after E040 that clearly change the trajectory moved the mean by 0.10-0.26 pp: E041 -0.26, E042 +0.16, E045 +0.18, E046 -0.10, E047 -0.18. Most tellingly, E044 (-0.23) and E048 (+0.02) apply the same 28px stage and get answers 0.25 pp apart. That fits a paired sd of ~0.12-0.15 pp. It does not fit <=0.06.

The whitening bias trains only in epoch 1 and is then frozen (E034), and in the tip epoch 1 runs entirely at low resolution. At 16px, antialiased downsampling changes the patch statistics a lot, so the whitening bias is fitted to blurred 16px images and then frozen for the 32px stages. The same confound may be quietly costing accuracy at 20px (E047, -0.18 pp). The 1x1 story has not been tested either.

(b) Run an 18px stage that keeps a 2x2 final map. If (a) recovers accuracy, the bias freeze is the real constraint on how cheap the warmup stage can be.

critiques.target: E048 surprise (28px stage free after costing -0.23 pp in E044)

The head-lr x2 or 20px changes in between may interact with the 28px stage. Or E044's -0.23 was itself mostly noise. These explanations predict different next steps: an interaction means the order of stacking matters, while noise means more low-res time may be available.

E050 found small maps latency-bound, so the low-res stages are where a bigger batch should help throughput most. Lookahead still syncs every 5 steps although steps fell by 1/3, and the (t/T)^3 schedule was never re-examined in sample terms.
critiques.suggestion: Next batch-size runs: (1) bs 3072 in the 20px and 28px stages only, keeping 1536 at 32px. (2) bs 2048 throughout, with the SGD lr scaled. Before each, time it in drafts/ the way the E041 gate did.

critiques.target: Epoch count on the current tip
critiques.issue: The epoch count has not been re-swept since E027 (bs 1024, no curriculum). The tip now runs 6.75 epochs with a different step count, bs and curriculum. The knee slope at this configuration is unknown, and the assumed 1.1 pp/epoch comes from a different recipe. There is also an untried trade: low-res epochs are almost free, so adding low-res epochs and removing full-res ones may beat trimming epochs uniformly.
critiques.suggestion: Try 6.5 total epochs with the 32px stage shortened and the low-res stages unchanged. Separately, try a stage made of extra 20px epochs added at the start. Both test whether the curriculum, rather than uniform epoch cuts, is the right place to spend time.

structured_output.summary:
The tree has fallen behind the results. H1 still says only update-side structure moves the knee and targets 5.6 s, but the tip is at 5.0 s, reached mostly through resolution-curriculum and batch-size reallocation. H5's 'no reallocation beats epochs' band is contradicted by E040, E047 and E048 and should be marked refuted for resolution.

The accuracy side is noisier than the tree admits. The tip's 0.22 pp margin was ratcheted up by force-keeping re-draw-sized gains (E024, E026, E042, E045) and discarding similar losses. The claimed <=0.06 pp paired sd is contradicted by post-E040 edits and by the same 28px stage costing -0.23 pp in E044 and +0.02 pp in E048. A paired sd of ~0.12-0.15 pp is the realistic figure, so most single-run deltas under 0.3 pp are inconclusive. The extra-seed checks (H4.1.2-4) that would size the 40-seed risk have never been run.

E028's 0.003 pp match suggests some hyperparameter edits may not take effect under compile, which would undermine several 'flat axis' closures. H1.6.6 is a cheap check that settles this. E050's collapse at 16px has an untested confound: the whitening bias is trained only during the low-res epoch 1 and then frozen. That confound may also be taxing the 20px tip.

Highest-value next steps:
1. Run H1.6.6 and confirm that E046 and E049 changed the final weights.
2. Evaluate the tip offline on extra seeds.
3. Test whether the whitening-bias freeze is costing accuracy at low resolution.
4. Run the neglected cheap systems cuts: projection frequency, NS2 with AOL, and the max-autotune check.
5. Try larger batches in the low-res stages and re-sweep epochs, putting full-res and low-res epochs on separate axes.
